Diagnosed the 2026-09-13 T-24 wipeout (14/14 missed): checkpoint collection windows were 15 minutes wide while the scheduled collector actually lands every ~15-45 minutes with queue jitter, so no run fell inside any window. Widened the collection window to target+90m, capped strictly before kickoff (Close: [kickoff-5, kickoff-1]); no window extends past kickoff, nothing captured after the fact. Not a model or threshold change: the promotion gate is untouched; research keeps using actual per-row capture times (target_at/deadline_at/ended_at) and per-quote observed_at. Regression test: a run 30 min after the T-24 target captures. CI green. No Odds API quota spent by this change itself.
